title: SRE Weekly Ops Sync: prep + action log (scratchpad)
content:
Purpose / audience:
- Quick working notes for Monday SRE ops sync (30m). Mostly for on-call rotation handoff, SLO posture, and follow-ups.
- Audience: eng-sre, oncall, platform owners. Use this to run through deck + highlight decisions.

Context / quick summary:
- Overall page volume is down ~8% week-over-week, but P2 pages have ticked up (notable for generate-api).
- Error budget burn for generate-api: 22% this week (monthly budget 100%, rolling). We should consider throttling configs if burn continues.
- Latency SLOs: p50/p95 targets exist per-client-tier. Observed p95 for small-requests route ~140ms (SLO 120ms). Need short-term mitigations.

Agenda (30m):
1) Roll call + oncall notes (5m)
2) SLO snapshot + trends (8m)
3) Top incidents since last sync (8m)
4) Action review and new tasks (7m)

SLO snapshot (metrics to present):
- generate-api availability SLO: 99.95% monthly. Current rolling: 99.96%.
- generate-api latency SLO (p95 <= 120ms): rolling p95 = 140ms (7-day median), 7-day tail shows spikes around 200-350ms during 02:00–05:00 UTC.
- embed-service error-rate SLO: target 0.5% => rolling 0.32% (good).
- cache-hit SLO for prefix-KV: target 65% => current 58% (regression after recent cache eviction change).

Paging trends (last 4 weeks):
- Week of 2026-03-15: 48 pages (7 P1, 18 P2, rest P3)
- Week of 2026-03-22: 55 pages (increase due to scheduled infra migration)
- Week of 2026-03-29: 50 pages
- Week of 2026-04-05: 45 pages (but P2 fraction increased to 45%)
Notes: P2 increase correlates to higher-latency alerts on generate-api and increased 5xx spikes during bursts.

Top incidents (brief notes):
- INC-2026-0405 (2026-04-06) — generate-api high tail latency during a Canary rollout of model v1.12.
  - Symptoms: p95 jumped to 320ms, frontend timeouts.
  - RCA: model kernel selection fallback to fp32 for some batch sizes, causing GPU stalls on a small subset of shards.
  - Mitigation: rolled back canary, increased shard buffer, temporarily restricted batch size to 8.
  - Follow-ups: engineering to add automated kernel fallback detection (owner: Marco Ruiz, due: 2026-04-17).

- INC-2026-0412 (2026-04-09) — Prefix cache eviction misconfiguration after deploy.
  - Symptoms: sudden drop in KV cache hit, higher token generation cost and latency.
  - RCA: eviction policy switched from LRU-weighted to time-windowed inadvertently.
  - Mitigation: revert eviction policy, added guard in CI.
  - Follow-ups: add cache-policy unit test + dashboard alert for cache-hit-rate < 60% (owner: Leah Chen, due: 2026-04-14).

Hypotheses to discuss in sync:
- Kernel fallback detection could be quick win vs long-term: 1) add telemetry to detect when kernel selection deviates at runtime; 2) set auto-rollback cadence during canaries.
- Cache-hit regression likely amplified error budget burn for generate-api; understand correlation with recent deploys to LRU change.

Action items (new):
- A1: Add Prometheus alert: generate_api_p95 > 200ms sustained for 5m => page to oncall and post to #sre-ops (owner: Asha Mehta, due: 2026-04-12).
- A2: Instrument kernel-selection telemetry and emit metric kernel_fallback_event{model,shard} (owner: Marco Ruiz, due: 2026-04-17).
- A3: Add cache-hit-rate < 60% alert and post incident playbook link in alert (owner: Leah Chen, due: 2026-04-14).
- A4: Write short runbook for throttling config changes for generate-api (owner: oncall rotation, assignee: TBD, due: 2026-04-20).

Existing action review (from last sync):
- Previous: investigate p95 spikes during 02–05 UTC (owner: Daniel Park) => short-term root cause appears to be batch reshuffling during GPU maintenance window. In progress; follow-up expected this week.
- Previous: add unit-test for cache eviction (owner: Leah Chen) => PR opened (#89), needs review.

Quick queries / dashboards to pull before meeting:
- PromQL (p95 latency):
  histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=\"generate-api\"}[5m])) by (le))
- PromQL (error rate):
  sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"generate-api\",status=~\"5..\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"generate-api\"}[5m]))
- BigQuery (pager count last 30 days):
  SELECT DATE(timestamp) as day, COUNT(*) as pages FROM `ops.pagerduty_events` WHERE service = 'generate-api' AND severity <= 2 GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 30;

Meeting prep checklist:
- Pull the 7-day SLO slides from Confluence SLO dashboard (link above).
- Confirm action owners are on the call / ping them beforehand.
- Prepare short demo of kernel fallback logs (10–20s snippet) if Marco is available.

Open questions / discussion points to surface:
- Do we want temporary throttles per-tenant to preserve global SLOs if spike is tenant-driven? Tradeoffs: customer impact vs global availability.
- Evaluate whether canary rollout checks should include kernel-selection sanity checks before increasing traffic.

Notes to self (scratch):
- If time is tight, prioritize: 1) A1 (alert), 2) A3 (cache alert + runbook link), 3) A2 (kernel telemetry).
- Tag PR #89 for expedited review in morning triage.
- Follow-up sync mid-week if actions show progress.

Action log (for copying into follow-up email after the sync):
- [A1] create alert for generate_api_p95 >200ms (Asha Mehta) — due 2026-04-12
- [A2] kernel-selection telemetry metric + alerting (Marco Ruiz) — due 2026-04-17
- [A3] cache-hit alert + runbook link (Leah Chen) — due 2026-04-14
- [A4] throttling runbook draft (rotation) — due 2026-04-20

Slack refs / quick links to paste in the meeting chat:
- #sre-ops (primary)
- Incident channel: #inc-2026-0405
- PR to review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/89

End of notes.

(If anything obvious missing, add before meeting and update this doc.)
